description: This file contains the definition of the Store class within the Opencart catalog model setting namespace. It includes methods to retrieve store information, create store instances, and manage store-related configuration, localization, and initialization processes.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Class responsible for managing store data, retrieval, creation of store instances, and related configuration processes within the Opencart system.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves the store data for a given store ID from the database.

methods.name: getStoreByHostname
methods.description: Retrieves store information based on the provided hostname or URL.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Fetches all store records, utilizing caching for performance.

methods.name: createStoreInstance
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new store instance, setting up necessary components, configuration, localization, and session details.
